mods.name: Gore Mod
mods.description: More blood: richer blood and hit effects. By cr1m3.

mods.name: IranCoJ Graphics
mods.description: The Edition's remastered graphics: GGX lighting and metal, ambient occlusion (GTAO), soft shadows, temporal anti-aliasing, sharpening and colour, and every map's detail and draw distances. Settings > Graphics > Remastered or Vanilla.

mods.name: IranCoJ HD Textures
mods.description: Every world texture of the game at twice its resolution, and your weapons and hands at four times. With Remastered graphics, the New Classes characters at their full CoJ Gunslinger size too. About 800 MB to download.

mods.name: IranCoJ HUD
mods.description: The Edition's in-game HUD: kill feed, chat, team score bar, Shootout / Wanted standing and weapon names.

mods.name: New Classes
mods.description: Rancher and Redneck as playable classes, and three classes play as CoJ Gunslinger characters: Silas Greaves (Rancher), John Wesley Hardin (Duelist) and Billy the Kid (Rifleman). With upgrades, new class pictures and the IranCoJ Skin Pack.

mods.name: No DOF & Motion Blur
mods.description: Turns off depth of field and motion blur for a sharper picture. By cr1m3.

mods.name: Server List Mod
mods.description: In-game server list through OpenSpy, plus direct join. Replaces CoJ2_x86.dll and engine_x86.dll; uninstalling puts the originals back.

scoreboard names, second copy of the same choice

header: K/D 15% -> 11%; with Players 37 and Accuracy 15 (unchanged) each title sits over its column

mods.name: Spectate Mod
mods.description: Spectate players in multiplayer, from the in-game menu.

mods.name: Third-Person Camera
mods.description: Over-the-shoulder third-person view. F5 switches first / third person, the middle mouse button swaps shoulders (keys in Settings). Skirmish and Manhunt are first person only.

mods.name: Voice Chat Mod
mods.description: In-game voice chat. Settings in voiceconfig.ini.

news.title: Light shafts and distant haze
news.text: Look towards the sun and light now streams past roofs, trees and hills. Far hills and the skyline get a light haze in each map's own fog colour, while every play distance stays clear. Both are new in Settings > Graphics > Remastered and cost no frame rate.

news.title: Sharper upscaling, no ghosts
news.text: Sharpening now uses AMD's FSR 1 sharpening: crisper with every Render resolution, without halos around edges. And temporal anti-aliasing recognises players who move, so a player running past no longer leaves a trail or a ghost behind.

news.title: More frames with Render resolution
news.text: Settings > Graphics > Remastered has a new Render resolution: the world is drawn at 85%, 75% or 67% of your resolution and temporal anti-aliasing rebuilds it at full size. The HUD and text stay sharp, and the game runs much faster - on a laptop at 1440p, 75% gave about 60% more frames and 67% almost twice as many. Needs Temporal anti-aliasing and launcher 3.0.0-beta.14. Also fixed: standing right at a wall, a reload no longer leaves a copy of your gun on it, and close-up edges no longer drag when you turn.

news.title: Smoother with Vulkan
news.text: The game now draws through Vulkan (DXVK) on every graphics card that supports it, and laptops always use their dedicated card. The frame rate holds steady: no more sudden stalls in the middle of a fight. Vertical sync is turned off once, because it held slower PCs to 30 or 20 fps; you can turn it back on in Settings > Display. Older cards stay on DirectX 9 by themselves, and Settings > Display > Renderer switches between the two. Needs launcher 3.0.0-beta.12.

news.title: No more gun on the wall
news.text: With temporal anti-aliasing on, reloading while standing still could leave a faint copy of your gun on the wall in front of you until you moved. Fixed.

news.title: No more crashes on WWL
news.text: Joining the WWL server could crash the game, at random moments and in random places. The game kept too little room for what a busy server like WWL sends, and the overflow broke other parts of the game. That room is now big enough, so WWL plays like any other server. It comes with the next update, nothing to set up.

news.title: Steadier, sharper anti-aliasing
news.text: Temporal anti-aliasing now holds the picture still at every resolution: no more shaking in the distance and no more flickering edges on roofs and rocks at lower resolutions. Moving around also looks sharper, especially below 1080p - 900p now looks close to 1080p. Turn it on in Settings > Graphics > Remastered > Temporal anti-aliasing.

news.title: Smooth spawns, visible protection
news.text: No more stutter when players spawn - not even when Hardin, Silas or Billy the Kid join the fight. And every character now glows while they are protected after spawning, so you can see at a glance who can't be hurt yet. Many characters from the skin pack never glowed before. Update the Edition and enjoy a smoother game.

news.title: Every skin, smooth and protected
news.text: Whatever skins you pick for your classes - IranCoJ, Vanilla or your own mix - they now spawn without stutter and glow while protected, in every mode. Try a new look for your favourite class.

news.title: No more respawn freezes
news.text: The game froze for about a quarter of a second whenever anyone spawned: the spawn-protection glow of every character was built from scratch each time. The glow is now built once, while the map loads, so spawns are smooth again with every skin. New Classes 2.0.9 also keeps its shader cache when you change graphics settings, instead of starting over each time.

news.title: One badge per team
news.text: The team score at the top of the screen in Posse and Manhunt now shows each team's own badge at its end of the bar: the Lawmen's blue sheriff's star and the Outlaws' skull under a hat, the same ones as on the scoreboard. Launcher 3.0.0-beta.8: custom skins show in team modes too, Rancher and Redneck hide their picture with a custom skin, and characters without a voice of their own also get the game's third multiplayer voice.

news.title: Rain maps fixed
news.text: Rain maps such as Utah looked smeared and grey with Remastered graphics: the rain's depth effect could not be built while No DOF & Motion Blur is installed, and the game drew a placeholder over the whole screen. Fixed - rain looks as it should again.

news.title: Temporal AA, fixed
news.text: Temporal anti-aliasing now does what it should: smooth, steady edges, wires and foliage, with no shaking when you stand still and no trails when you move. Rivers and shores on Tombstone, Civil, Frisco, Fort Stanton and other maps no longer glow yellow in Remastered, and long bullet traces draw properly again. Turn it on in Settings > Graphics > Remastered > Temporal anti-aliasing.

news.title: Fixes: joining, map names
news.text: On most PCs the map name on the loading screen showed as a red box, or too big for its place: the sharp title font it uses was missing. The Edition now brings it along. With Remastered graphics on, joining a server could fail with a wrong map CRC: IranCoJ Graphics 1.1.1 fixes that. Launcher 3.0.0-beta.3: the Edition shortcut while the launcher is open plays from the open launcher instead of starting a second one, and Vanilla graphics give the game its own anti-aliasing back.

news.title: Your Edition stands on its own
news.text: The original game is only needed to create the Edition: after that the Edition updates from its own files, so you may uninstall the original if you want the space. New Editions can bring your profiles over from the game, and Settings > IranCoJ Edition has a button that copies any you don't have yet. Remastered graphics remember your choice while HD Textures isn't installed and turn on by themselves once it is, and uninstalling HD Textures gives New Classes its own characters back.

news.title:
The launcher
is in beta
news.text: Everything IranCoJ Launcher 3 is meant to do is here: the Edition, maps, mods, servers, the leaderboard and remastered graphics. From now on it is fixes and polish. The Edition shortcut on your desktop now opens the launcher, which updates itself, the Edition, maps and mods before the game starts. Found a bug? Let us know.

news.title:
Bound in Blood
Multiplayer
news.text: A separate multiplayer copy of your game with every IranCoJ map and mod. Your original game stays untouched.

news.title: Remastered graphics
news.text: Bound in Blood, remastered: physically based sun highlights and metal, ground-truth ambient occlusion, soft shadows on a 4096 map, temporal anti-aliasing, filmic colour, buildings, trees and props at full detail to the horizon, and three times the vegetation distance. Turn each part on or off in Settings > Graphics > Remastered, or go back to Vanilla. Remastered comes with IranCoJ HD Textures (install it in Mods): every texture at twice its resolution, your weapons and hands at four times, and the New Classes characters at full size. Needs launcher 3.0.0-beta.1.

news.title:
The leaderboard,
right here
news.text: The community leaderboard is now in the launcher: all time, this month or this week, with or without bot matches. Search any outlaw and open their full record.

news.title: Chat fixes
news.text: IranCoJ HUD 1.0.1: a wider chat that shows whole messages, names in team colours (orange without a team), green team chat and red server messages, shades that fit the kill feed and chat, the chat on the scoreboard from the moment you join, and no chat or kill feed over the class screen.

news.title: A new HUD
news.text: The whole in-game HUD is redrawn: sharper icons, a team score bar with the Lawmen star and the Outlaws skull, a cleaner kill feed with streak cards, a chat that colours names and tags and keeps five lines, your weapon's name when you switch, and a new Shootout and Wanted standing. Menus and loading screens got tidier too.

news.title: Third Person 1.0.5
news.text: Press F5 for an over-the-shoulder view. Your character now moves naturally on screen, the camera glides between first and third person, and the middle mouse button swaps shoulders. Skirmish and Manhunt stay first person.

news.title: Spectate Mod 1.1.1
news.text: Switching between first and third person glides like the Third-Person Camera, and the face hides at the same moment it does there. First-person spectating keeps the dot crosshair.

news.title: New Classes 2.0.6
news.text: Silas Greaves, John Wesley Hardin and Billy the Kid as the Rancher, Duelist and Rifleman. 2.0.6 brings the remastered tomahawk icon, no hands in the sniper scope and the crosshair styles.

news.title: Lincoln Town
news.text: The biggest map in the pack so far. It downloads with your next map update.

news.title: Showdown on IranCoJ
news.text: Join the IranCoJ server straight from the launcher, no menus needed.
